title: Disappearing Ink: Obfuscation Breaks N-gram Code Watermarks in Theory and Practice
abstract: arXiv:2507.05512v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, making reliable identification of machine-generated code important for attribution, tracking, and misuse detection. Existing code watermarking methods are dominated by N-gram-based schemes, yet their robustness has mostly been evaluated only against simple edits or optimizations. We argue that this significantly overstates security, because software engineering already provides stronger semantics-preserving transformations in the form of code obfuscation.   We study N-gram-based code watermarking under obfuscation. We formally model semantics-preserving transformations as a Markov random walk and prove that, under an intuitive and experimentally supported assumption called distribution consistency, obfuscation can nullify the robustness of N-gram-based watermarks. translated_title: 消失的墨水：代码混淆在理论与实践上破解N-gram代码水印
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于代码生成，这使得可靠地识别机器生成的代码对于归因、追踪和滥用检测变得至关重要。现有的代码水印方法以基于N-gram的方案为主，但其鲁棒性大多仅在简单编辑或优化的对抗下进行评估。我们认为这显著高估了其安全性，因为软件工程领域本身已经提供了更强的语义保持变换手段，即代码混淆。我们研究了代码混淆攻击下基于N-gram的代码水印。我们将语义保持变换形式化为马尔可夫随机游走，并证明在一个称为“分布一致性”的直观且经实验支持的假设下，混淆可以使基于N-gram的水印的鲁棒性完全失效。如果原始检测器的假阳性率为fpr，那么在混淆之后，其失败率……
tldr: 该论文通过将语义保持变换建模为马尔可夫随机游走，从理论和实验上证明代码混淆可以使基于N-gram的代码水印鲁棒性失效，揭示了现有水印方法的安全性被显著高估。
en_tdlr: By modeling semantics-preserving transformations as a Markov random walk, this paper proves both theoretically and empirically that code obfuscation can nullify the robustness of N-gram-based code watermarks, revealing that the security of existing watermarking methods has been significantly overstated.
